Draw a ROSE timing plot table set

Source: R/seq_rose_timing.R
seq_rose_timing.Rd

Thin adapter that turns a plot_timing table set written by ROSE into a seq_plot() built from the generic timing elements (seq_cross_arch(), seq_step_ribbon(), seq_paired_ribbon(), seq_interval_glyph(), seq_tile_mix(), seq_node_link(), seq_span_strip()). The tables carry every position, interval, opacity, label and colour category, so the adapter only selects rows, renames columns, looks up palette colours and sets axes. Proxy rows are order bounds, not times. Glyph rows without a position, such as a whole-genome doubling, are drawn across every window at their given y.

Usage

seq_rose_timing(
  x,
  layout = c("arches", "order", "heatmap", "poset"),
  poset_view = c("poset", "hasse", "groups"),
  palette = NULL,
  show_hidden = FALSE,
  plain = FALSE,
  cytobands = NULL,
  legend_width = 0.2,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A directory holding the plot_timing.* files, or a list of data frames with a schema_version element or attribute. Read with seq_read_table_set().

layout

One of "arches" (SV arches over copy number with step ribbons), "order" (arches at their poset layer), "heatmap" (arches over a two-channel timing heatmap) or "poset" (node-link view).

poset_view

For layout = "poset": "poset" (all edges), "hasse" (reduction edges only) or "groups" (group boxes only).

palette

Named list merged over the default palettes. Entries are sv, step, cn, sbs, heatmap, glyph and node (named colour vectors), annotation (named colours by colour_key) and edge (named lists of color, linetype and linewidth).

show_hidden

Logical. Add a strip for glyph rows marked hidden.

plain

Logical. Draw a genomic x axis on the last timing track instead of an ideogram.

cytobands

Cytoband GRanges for the ideogram. Defaults to load_cytobands().

legend_width

Right margin of the page, as a fraction, left for the legends.

...

Passed to seq_plot().

Value

A SeqPlot that can be extended with %+%.

Examples

d <- system.file("extdata", "rose", "timing", "sim_bfb_amplicon", package = "SeqPlotR")
if (nzchar(d)) {
  p <- seq_rose_timing(d, layout = "arches", plain = TRUE)
}
